title: Can do descriptor
description: One element of content/<lang>/candos/<level>.json. The file is a JSON array of these objects. Every descriptor in candos/<level>.json must have that level.

key.description: Stable key, <lang>:cando:<code>. core-content maps it to a uuid on install.

code.description: LEVEL.SKILL.NN as defined in docs/05-curriculum-spine.md. Shared across languages so progress views line up.

text_en.description: The descriptor in English. For CEFR skills a close paraphrase of the Companion Volume wording.

text_native.description: The descriptor in the target language. Optional, shown from B1 up.

source.description: A source id from pack.json sources, or the literal string unverified.

source_note.description: Scale name, page or sequence number inside the source.

sequence_ref.description: For GRA and VOC descriptors: the row in the language grammar sequence in docs/05, for example A1.3.

mastery_rule.description: Overrides for the default mastery rule in docs/04-module-contracts.md. Omit to use the default.

reviewed.description: True once a human has checked this descriptor against its source.
